title: Towards Generalist Models for Molecular Property Prediction: Distilling Verbalized Knowledge from Decision Trees
abstract: arXiv:2603.12344v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular Property Prediction (MPP) is a fundamental problem in drug discovery that has recently attracted growing attention. Large Language Models (LLMs), known for their impressive proficiency across domains, show promise as generalist models for MPP. However, their current performance remains below the threshold needed for practical adoption. To bridge this gap, we propose TreeKD for distilling the knowledge of tree-based specialist models into LLMs to complement the internal knowledge of LLMs and improve their predictive accuracy. For each property, we train a specialist decision tree using features derived from 40K functional groups in the input molecules. Then, the predictive rule learned by the decision tree, which encodes its knowledge, is verbalized and incorporated into the prompts for training LLMs. In addition, by replacing a single decision tree with a Random Forest, we introduce a test-time scaling technique called rule

translated_title: 迈向分子性质预测的通才模型：从决策树中蒸馏言语化知识
translated_abstract: 分子性质预测（MPP）是药物发现中的一个基本问题，近年来受到越来越多的关注。大语言模型（LLM）以其跨领域的出色能力而闻名，有望成为分子性质预测的通才模型。然而，其当前性能仍低于实际应用所需的门槛。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 TreeKD，将基于树的专家模型的知识蒸馏到 LLM 中，以补充 LLM 的内部知识并提高其预测准确性。对于每个性质，我们使用从输入分子中提取的 40K 个官能团特征训练一个专家决策树。然后，将决策树学到的、编码其知识的预测规则进行言语化，并将其纳入用于训练 LLM 的提示词中。此外，通过用随机森林替换单个决策树，我们引入了一种称为规则……的测试时扩展技术。
tldr: 提出 TreeKD 方法，将基于决策树的专家模型知识言语化并蒸馏到 LLM 中，从而提升大语言模型在分子性质预测任务上的准确性。
en_tdlr: TreeKD distills verbalized knowledge from tree-based specialist models into LLMs to improve their predictive accuracy on molecular property prediction.
